takes.overview: 2-0 and still #1 in projected strength with 97% playoff odds - nobody else is above 79%. The weak spot has moved from D to forwards: F is #3 in quality and #4 rest of season, so that's where buying should go now. Hellebuyck (suspended, IR) and Bedard (shoulder, IR) stay flagged, not discounted - Bedard might be available Tuesday vs Pittsburgh per Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times; check news before setting Tuesday's lineup.

With 0 of 6 adds used, stream into the open skater slots on Wednesday, Friday and Sunday - Hartman for Granlund (+3.6, plays Mon/Tue/Thu/Sun) is the top move. Next week vs PuttinOnTheFoil leans your way (56%), but Wednesday Oct 21 you have zero starts to their 3.
takes.roster: Celebrini, Bouchard (23.5 pts already), Hughes and Seider are the core; Swayman (30.8 pts, 6.16/gm pace) is your best goalie. Gauthier (upper body, day-to-day) left Monday's practice early - check news before Tuesday. Among skaters, McKenna (115 ROS) and McCann (118) are the cleanest cuts; McCann is the drop in both top adds (Thomas, Hartman).
